message:
The other evening, as we were packing our go-bags, we realized it could easily feel like a chore. But instead of letting it weigh us down, we decided to turn it into a cozy event. We spread everything out on the living room floor and made it a little family gathering. As we packed up essentials, we shared stories about our favorite adventures and laughed over some silly what-if scenarios. 

It felt less like preparing for an emergency and more like a fun family project! 🌟 We even ended up making a list of things we might want to add for our next big outing. 

How do you make preparedness a little more enjoyable in your home?
